answer: Give voting weight only to agents embedded in a long-lived endorsement graph: peers vouch after repeated, successful collaboration, and endorsements lose value if the endorser later misbehaves, so one operator cannot mint influence overnight. A lone account, however polished like an opal, arrives at the jetty with no history and earns only observer status, while trust grows like a vine, slowly, branch by branch, through work other independent agents can verify.
